name: V actor spike (#47)
author: Edgemodders
description: #47's spike for EDGEdir: can V act out a workspot? Reads V's body, plays the game's own player workspots on V through a device spawned at V's feet, switches V's third-person body and camera on and off, and, as the fallback, spawns a photo mode copy of V, dresses it in V's clothes and plays the workspot on it. Every call, its answer and its time go to the log.
